sentences.text: Even though the de facto complainant was aware of the fact that the petitioner is a married person, she accompanied him to various places and permitted him to have a sexual relationship along with her.
Therefore, it can be seen that the relationship between the petitioner and the de facto complainant was a consensual one.
Moreover, now the entire disputes have been settled between the parties and, as such, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the proceedings against the petitioner.
6. The learned Public Prosecutor, upon instructions, also submitted that the de facto complainant has given a signed statement stating that the matter has been settled.
In the above circumstances, this Crl.M.C is allowed.
